sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by non-permeabilized immunofluorescence/flow cytometry (L2); LPHN3 extracellular domain binding preserved (L4).
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly names S30 (canonical residue 30, verified: seq[29]='S') as the first FLRT3 residue of the construct, with the myc tag N-terminal to it; the junction is therefore after canonical K29 and before S30 (insert_after_residue=29). The native signal peptide (1–28) is replaced by the preprotrypsin leader, so the tag is correctly positioned after the cleavage site and is >500 residues from the TM boundary. L2 validates extracellular surface exposure by non-permeabilized staining; L4 shows LPHN3 binding is intact, confirming the tag does not disrupt the FLRT3 ectodomain. Full-length human FLRT3 (residues S30–S649) expressed in HEK293 cells with a preprotrypsin leader sequence bearing an N-terminal myc tag (pCMV5); L2 confirms surface display by non-permeabilized anti-myc staining and flow cytometry; L4 confirms ecto-LPHN3-Fc binding to FLRT3-myc-expressing cells.

sources.claim: For mammalian expression and functional analysis, full length human FLRT3 (residues S30–S649), human LPHN3 (residues F20-L1447), and human Unc5B (G27-E934; Uniprot ID: Q8IZJ1 ), and mouse Unc5D (S46-L884) constructs with preprotrypsin leader sequence containing N-terminal myc, FLAG, His and His-tags, respectively, were cloned into pCMV5.

literature_notes: L3 (PMC4210639) reports full-length FLRT3 (residues 29–649) with a C-terminal mVenus/His tag in pHLSec for cell visualization. The C-terminus of FLRT3 is intracellular (residues 551–649 per topology landmarks), so this tag is not an extracellular surface site and is recorded in other_positions. L4 (PMC3326387) describes the same FLRT3-myc construct as L1/L2 and corroborates function; it is not a separate site. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for FLRT3.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length FLRT3 (residues 29–649) cloned with a C-terminal mVenus and polyhistidine tag; the C-terminus (residue 649) is intracellular (topology 551–649), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
